tables.name: gold.brg_trial_condition
tables.description: Trial to MeSH descriptor. Many-to-many - aggregate through it with COUNT DISTINCT.

columns.name: relation
columns.description: direct | ancestor - how the descriptor relates to the trial's conditions

tables.name: gold.brg_trial_condition_text
tables.description: Trial to condition as registered in free text. Complements the MeSH bridge, which misses trials the registry never mapped.

columns.name: condition_text
columns.description: Condition exactly as the sponsor registered it

columns.name: condition_text_lower
columns.description: Lower-cased condition text for case-insensitive matching

tables.name: gold.brg_trial_country
tables.description: Trial to country with at least one site.

columns.name: is_placebo
columns.description: Whether this arm's intervention is a placebo

tables.name: gold.brg_trial_sponsor
tables.description: Trial to resolved sponsor, lead and collaborators.

tables.name: gold.dim_condition
tables.description: One row per MeSH descriptor any trial maps to.

columns.name: mesh_id
columns.description: MeSH descriptor ID as supplied by the registry

columns.name: trials_direct
columns.description: Trials whose conditions map to this descriptor directly

columns.name: trials_direct_or_descendant
columns.description: Trials mapping to this descriptor or any descriptor beneath it

tables.name: gold.dim_intervention
tables.description: One row per resolved product or intervention.

columns.name: synonym_count
columns.description: Number of names resolved to this product

columns.name: is_placebo
columns.description: Whether this entity is a placebo

tables.name: gold.dim_sponsor
tables.description: One row per resolved sponsor entity.

columns.name: sponsor_name
columns.description: Display name - the most frequent registered spelling

columns.name: sponsor_class
columns.description: INDUSTRY | NIH | FED | OTHER_GOV | NETWORK | INDIV | OTHER

columns.name: raw_name_variants
columns.description: Number of distinct registered spellings folded into this sponsor

columns.name: parent_sponsor_key
columns.description: Parent company where the registry itself states one; else null

columns.name: group_sponsor_name
columns.description: Display name at the roll-up level

tables.name: gold.fct_trial
tables.description: The trial fact. One row per trial; every governed metric is defined at this grain.

columns.name: brief_title
columns.description: Short public title of the trial

columns.name: overall_status
columns.description: Registry recruitment status; UNRECOGNISED if outside the registry's code list

columns.name: status_group
columns.description: ongoing | completed | stopped | unknown - status collapsed for analysis

columns.name: phase_label
columns.description: Phase, keeping combinations such as PHASE2/PHASE3; NA for non-drug trials

columns.name: phase_rank
columns.description: Highest phase reached, 0 = early phase 1 to 4 = phase 4; null if not applicable

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Start date; month-only registry dates are set to the 1st - see start_date_precision

columns.name: start_date_precision
columns.description: day | month - how precise start_date really is

columns.name: enrollment_actual
columns.description: Participants actually enrolled; null unless the registry marks the count ACTUAL

columns.name: enrollment_planned
columns.description: Anticipated enrollment; null unless the registry marks the count ESTIMATED

columns.name: enrollment_type
columns.description: ACTUAL | ESTIMATED - which of the two columns above is populated

columns.name: has_results
columns.description: Whether results are posted on the registry

columns.name: has_central_contact
columns.description: Whether a central contact is published. Derived from whether a contact row exists, never from contact values - deliberately has no source path, which is what keeps it clear of the PII lineage check.

columns.name: last_update_posted
columns.description: Date the registry record was last updated

tables.name: gold.rag_chunks
tables.description: Retrieval chunks of each trial's summary and eligibility text.

columns.name: chunk_ord
columns.description: Position of the chunk within its section

tables.name: gold.rag_chunks_enriched
tables.description: Chunks with governed trial attributes attached for filtered retrieval.

tables.name: silver.intervention_alias
tables.description: Every known name for every product, with how far it can be trusted.

tables.name: silver.map_intervention
tables.description: Raw intervention name to resolved product entity.

tables.name: silver.map_sponsor
tables.description: Raw sponsor spelling to resolved sponsor entity, with registry-stated parent.

tables.name: silver.trial
tables.description: One row per trial at its latest registry version, typed and conformed.

tables.name: silver.trial_contact_flag
tables.description: Whether a trial publishes a central contact - derived from row existence only.

tables.name: staging.stg_contacts
tables.description: Central contacts listed on each trial. Personal data; stops at staging.

columns.name: ordinal
columns.description: Position of the contact in the registry record
